title: Petra and the Gravity
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Quintana, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
